canonicalBytes: UTF-8, LF, JSON ensure_ascii=true/sort_keys=true/indent=2/final newline; XML ElementTree serialization UTF-8 declaration/LF final newline; SQL UTF-8/LF final newline. File integrity compares exact bytes after CRLF-to-LF checkout normalization only; no other normalization.
derivation: UTF-8 compact JSON arrays, ensure_ascii=true, separators=(comma,colon), no newline. Seed = SHA256(["missions-generator-1",1701,category,mission-key,event-key]); mission-key is the canonical ST-... missionId for cost/timing streams and empty for initial offset streams; event-key is empty for initial offsets, "initial" for initial estimates, "causal-start" for causal start delay, otherwise the curated "event-N" key. Blocks = SHA256(seed bytes + unsigned 64-bit big-endian counter starting at zero). Uniform inclusive integer draw uses 256-bit rejection sampling.
ordering: Fixed input roster; sequential mission ordinals; generate ascending missionId/local event order, then assign decimal changeIds by changedAt/missionId/local event index.

references.limitation: Missions-local opaque IDs; no suffix/alias-based Personnel mapping or canonical external registry claim.

terminalTiming: Final terminal event is fixed to first event plus durationHours; closure dwell can exceed a draw band and is explicitly labeled duration-closure. Nonterminal draws are bounded by remaining duration and minimum future gaps.
